description.value: Swiws Spirit Tours is an Osoyoos-based tour operator offering guided wine tours through the Oliver-Osoyoos wine region and Indigenous cultural tours led by members of the Osoyoos Indian Band (syilx nation). Their Spotted Lake tour departs from the Nk'Mip Desert Cultural Centre and includes a guided walk and a snakes-alive show. For a touring cyclist looking to explore the South Okanagan's wineries without pedalling, this company offers pick-up and drop-off at local accommodations.
